budget_items.topic: FY2025 order cancelled by vendor failure, expense moved to FY2026
budget_items.what_was_recorded: An FY25 library materials order with Baker & Taylor did not ship because the vendor went out of business, so the expense moves into the FY2026 budget; the Town Manager said encumbering unreceived orders at year end is no longer allowed.
budget_items.quote: muir placed an order for $1,300 in fy25 with baker & taylor, a library materials supplier who has since gone out of business.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager told the Director he can no longer encumber items ordered but not received before fiscal year end, so spending down accounts must change.
budget_items.quote: he can no longer encumber items ordered, but not received before the end of the fiscal year.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Library funds were reported as 34% expended with the fiscal year 39% complete.
budget_items.quote: the fiscal year calendar is 39% complete and library funds are 34% expended.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Two grant applications were submitted: one to the Bemis Community Fund and one to the Emerson Hospital Catherine Gallery Community Grant. The Director's report prints the Bemis figure as $1000.
budget_items.quote: one is for $1,000 from the bemis community fund for five monthly sessions of music and movement storytime

budget_items.topic: Friends book sale and bake sale proceeds
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Friends reported book sale and bake sale proceeds totalling $3,459.
budget_items.quote: the fall book sale brought in $2,340, and the bake sale brought in $1,119 for a total of $3,459.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Kate Ravelette guaranteed a donation to the Friends of 1K regardless of bake sale earnings, with all proceeds going to the Friends.
budget_items.quote: she guaranteed a donation of 1k, regardless of how much is earned from the bake sale.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The adult programs report as of 11/1/2025 shows a grand total budget of $14,600, with 26% spent, 33% encumbered and 41% remaining.
